thread:
aj: Quick RFC follow-up: we need an operator contract so on-prem upgrades don't leave nodes half-applied.
maria: Strong agree. Proposal: staged apply with durable on-disk markers + reconciler TTL.
devon: Prefer resume-token + index-first streaming over 2PC for air-gapped installs - simpler and idempotent.
sandeep: Ops note: current operator timeout=5m. Real sites need longer. Suggest default -> 30m and allow per-cluster override.
aj: Don't widen global timeouts. Allow extended timeouts only when cluster annotated `maintenance=true` or operator reports `low_load`.
jamie: Add manifest fields: `applyPhase=prepare|activate|finalize`, `resumeToken`, chunk hashes. Operator can surface current_phase.
devon: Proposed sequence:
```
1) fetch index (index-first)
2) apply blobs with periodic checkpoint
3) write marker PREPARED (resumeToken + applied-hash)
4) activation (swap symlink / image)
5) write marker COMMITTED
```
maria: Each checkpoint validated via signed compact manifest to avoid corrupt resumes.
sandeep: If PREPARED and operator crashes before COMMITTED: resume or rollback? Need reconciler policy.
aj: TTL-based reconciler: prepared_TTL default=48h. If expired, reconciler resumes if blobs present & signatures valid; otherwise trigger rollback to last-good.
jamie: Two-image swap safer but uses disk. For constrained appliances allow `rollback.strategy=inplace-tombstone`.
devon: Policy should be cluster-scoped with per-deployment overrides.
sandeep: Observability: expose last_checkpoint, bytes_applied, activation_attempts, current_phase, resume_token, and last_successful_image. Alert if activation_attempts > 3.
aj: Action items:
- RFC: staged phases + resume token + TTL (maria)
- operator: checkpoint API, durable checkpoint, resume logic, tests (devon)
- playbook + runbooks (jamie)
- metrics/dashboards/alerts (sandeep)
infra-bot: operator/v2 rollout to staging scheduled 2025-05-14 02:00 UTC :calendar:
maria: I'll own the RFC edits and schema changes. Ping me on the PR for quick review.
aj: If no objections I'll mark RFC ready for review tomorrow and schedule 30m sync. :rocket:
